area: Secure by Design: authentication, session, scope, secrets, configuration and supply chain
title: Wave 6 recheck after Wave 5: UI token, origin and Host checks, readiness token decode, sample tenant and snapshots, standalone edition, secrets in every sink, least privilege, supply chain, scope rule

checks.what: Every route derived from app.routes (Wave 5 routes included) answers 401 without a valid UI token; only the pinned public routes answer
Every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE route, derived from app.routes, refuses a cross-site form post (Origin and Referer), also with the gate off
With ZSCALER_UI_AUTH=0 every route, derived from app.routes, refuses a non-loopback Host (DNS rebinding)
No route reachable without the UI token shows a tenant name, role or licence the app holds
The access token decode never raises and quotes nothing on malformed, oversized, deeply nested or numerically huge tokens
The unverified token claims are read only by the readiness routes, sign-in display and the API access page; no gate uses them
Neither the token, its signature nor a raw claim reaches the readiness answer, job log, /latest, /permissions or the console
Every tenant-reading route of the scope table runs on the sample tenant with every socket call refused and recorded: none attempted
With a snapshot open, every write route missing any one of the four gates is refused before sign-in, nothing written
With a snapshot open and every gate held, a bulk change and a pack deployment change nothing and send nothing
A saved or opened snapshot holds no credential, password, policy/device/machine/feed token or provisioning key value
The standalone edition binds 127.0.0.1 whatever ZSCALER_BIND_HOST or local_settings.env say
The standalone edition always requires the UI token, minted fresh every start (ZSCALER_UI_AUTH=0 and ZSCALER_UI_TOKEN ignored)
The standalone edition starts read-only whatever the environment or local_settings.env say (ENABLE_WRITE_ACTIONS ignored)
Code passed on the command line is refused; only the regex worker's exact call runs
An access token echoed by an API error reaches no job log, result, bulk-test export, Client Connector install answer, audit line or file
A typed client secret, also pasted into a POV, is in no POV file, export, Word or PDF report or audit line
The job runner's log and error and the crash log (server.log, debug answer) mask an echoed bearer token
The one-time ZPA provisioning key is in no job poll, result, audit line or record and is revealed once (existing tests, re-run)
Every sign-in route (derived from the request models) returns, logs and audits no echoed client secret, password or API key
Snapshots, POVs, POV templates and the stores beside them are 0600 files in 0700 folders with a umask of 0; bulk-test results stay in memory
Atomic writes use mkstemp beside the target (unguessable, owner-only, replaced, never left) and every temporary pattern is git- and docker-ignored
The sample/snapshot cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Secure behind a TLS proxy
Every route in app.routes, sent tenant details and an empty Scope page, builds no client and reads nothing unless EXEMPT says why
With every other scope ticked, a single-product route reads nothing of the product left unticked
Every pip install (CI, Docker, installers, updater, release) is --require-hashes from a .lock
checks.standard: SLSA v1.0 Build L2 · Scorecard Pinned-Dependencies

checks.what: Every workflow is read-only at the top; write scopes only on the job that needs them
release-standalone.yml uses actions pinned by commit SHA and persist-credentials: false
PROVENANCE on means attestation must succeed and every archive is verified before publishing; off is stated in the notes
checks.standard: SLSA v1.0 Build L2 · SSDF PS.3.2

checks.what: pip-audit 2.10.1 --disable-pip --strict over requirements.lock, -dev, -ci and -pip through the proxy: no known vulnerabilities (2026-10-29)
docs/sbom.cdx.json lists exactly the locked packages with licences and a complete dependency graph

A static analysis tool runs in CI. Closed in Wave 7 (docs/qa/findings/w7-sast.json): bandit gates every test run at medium severity and up (tests/test_sast.py, make sast), and CodeQL security-extended scans Python and JavaScript on pull requests to dev, qa and main and weekly (.github/workflows/codeql.yml: its own job with security-events: write, SHA-pinned actions)

findings.title: The API access page (reachable without the UI token) showed the latest readiness answers: tenant name, API role, licences and what works
findings.fix: /permissions renders the live part only for a caller who passes security.ui_request_ok, no-store when it does

findings.title: The access token decode raised OverflowError on an exp or iat integer too large for a float
findings.fix: readiness._iso bounds the number before any arithmetic

findings.title: A saved or opened snapshot kept the values of policyToken, deviceToken, machineToken, authenticationToken and provisioningKey fields
findings.fix: offline_tenant.scrub masks text values under token and key names (true/false switches stay)

findings.title: An API error page that repeats the Authorization header put the OneAPI access token into Path analyzer and Test a list job logs, results and exports, POV evidence and the install command builder's answer
findings.fix: The raw client masks every error text it returns (secrets and its own token); tenant_auth.mask_secrets and SDK error texts redact bearer tokens, JWTs and session ids by shape

findings.title: The standalone edition started with writes on from ENABLE_WRITE_ACTIONS (environment or a local_settings.env any program of the user can write) and took a fixed, never-rotated ZSCALER_UI_TOKEN
findings.fix: standalone_main.configure ignores both with a notice; the smoke test starts the build with both set

findings.title: A typed client secret pasted into another field of a request (a POV's customer or notes) was written to the audit log in clear
findings.fix: audit.redact masks the request's own secret values wherever they appear in it

findings.title: The job runner's log and error and the crash log (server.log and the debug answer) kept an exception's text unmasked
findings.fix: pack_jobs and the exception handler pass the text through tenant_auth.redact_tokens

findings.title: The sample/snapshot cookie lacked Secure behind a TLS reverse proxy (X-Forwarded-Proto), unlike the UI token cookie
findings.fix: The cookie uses security._https like the UI token cookie
